definition: to cram something into a tight space
description: At an outdoor eating contest a young woman with long braids in a tie-dye shirt tips a plastic cup of water into her mouth, her throat working as she gulps. She then takes a cheeseburger from the tray in front of her and forces bite after bite into her mouth as fast as she can, cheeks bulging, while a crowd behind the barrier claps and cheers. A wide shot shows a whole row of competitors doing the same along a long table.

en.question: What is the woman with braids doing?

de.answer: Sie stopft sich einen Burger in den Mund.
de.question: Was macht die Frau mit den Zöpfen?

es.answer: Se está metiendo una hamburguesa en la boca.
